page.notes: The word "cbnitentes" is printed as "cbni-tentes" at the line end; it is probably a printing error for "obnitentes", left as printed. The spelling "posseret" and "distinentes" are kept as printed. The catchword "sociis" is set with a long s, and the running head is in small capitals.
